title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Sour Peach Gummy
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only The Sour Peach Gummy Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack refreshes your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K kit with a bright, tangy fruit twist. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, offering up to 10,000 puffs when used with the Dojo Blast device. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod system is supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle technology to maintain steady vapour and flavour delivery across use. This flavour recreates the taste of chewy fruit flavour confectionery, blending juicy Peach with a sour-sugared edge. Sweet yet tart, it’s a nostalgic vape that stays lively and satisfying throughout the day. With transparent pods for easy monitoring and a mess-free refill process, it’s designed for both ease and enjoyment.
